decisions.reason: The training programme is a service built on the firm's deep knowledge of its own machines and was given sustained visibility in 2018 and 2019, so it is likely to be retained as a complementary offer.

A fourth rotary axis accessory fits closely with the firm's existing machine-tool knowledge and customer base, and although it was only briefly mentioned online, its technical relatedness makes it worth keeping.

Hybrid additive post-processing is more distant from the firm's established knowledge base and appears to have had limited market emphasis, so the firm is more likely to redeploy resources away from it.
A high-speed CNC milling machine sits at the core of the firm's accumulated engineering and commercialization capabilities, and its dedicated product page suggests a serious strategic commitment.
An automatic tool change system is a highly related extension of the firm's machinery expertise and complements its installed base, making continued market presence likely.
